title: Backups & Restore
subtitle: 1-click compressed .tar.gz snapshots with atomic restore and scheduling
empty_desc: Create your first 1-click snapshot to protect your apps' settings, databases, and volumes.
search_placeholder: Filter by app or file name...
confirm_delete_permanent: Are you sure you want to permanently delete {{filename}}?
restore_warning_desc: Restoration stops the Docker stack for {{app}}, replaces all configuration files and persistent data with those in the backup, and restarts the stack.
backup_pause_notice: To ensure strict data consistency without corruption, the Docker stack will be briefly paused during compression and restarted immediately.
runs_background: Runs in background via internal scheduler
unselected_apps_all_notice: * If no app is individually checked, the routine will back up all installed apps.
scope_full_system_desc: Orbit configurations, credentials, integrations (HA, Cloudflare, Pi-hole, Samba) and all containers and volumes
scope_configs_only_desc: Only authentication, 2FA, integrations, links and preferences (instant and lightweight)
scope_all_containers_desc: All managed applications, compose files, variables and data from /data/apps
scope_single_app_desc: Choose an individual application for a targeted snapshot
restore_system_full_warning: This restore is global. It will restore all Orbit credentials, integration files, and data for all managed containers and stacks.
restore_configs_warning: This restore will restore all Orbit credentials, authentication, users, and integration settings.
